about: VerSe's 374 image series and the 355 patients they belong to, from TUM's published demographics table as VerSeFusion carries it; tools/gold3_field.py reads the patient as the person key (verse:<patient>). Ages are years at the scan, null where the table leaves them blank. Sex is left out, as nothing here reads it.

source.reader: src/verse_pipeline/utils/demographics.py load_demographics (column A the patient, column B the series where a patient has several)
